_comment: Defect declarations for the support replay clip (demos/support_demo.json); see demos/README.md, Sidecar declarations.

overlap.reason: Team 1's Infantry (uid 6) reaches melee contact at the end of the clip (its count drops 120 -> 117 by tick 780) and compresses into the press: CI website demo-diff on PR #1677 measured a minimum neighbour distance of 1.318 wu against the 2.25 wu floor, merge-base 6.89, where contact came earlier and the sampled ticks missed it. Press-adjacent compression at contact, not standing interpenetration.

shape_residual.reason: Team 1's cavalry squadron (uid 8, 9 ranks, 960 wu deep) now deploys with its front rank on its line and marches a long diagonal toward its target, so the deep block spends the clip mid-turn and its rear ranks trail its grid: the same deep-block mid-turn mechanism declared for uid 8 in cycle-charge.json (#1546). CI website demo-diff on PR #1677: worst 77.78 wu against the 30 wu floor, merge-base 3.199.
